metadata.description: In the LLM era, you fix the skill, not the code. A self-compounding workflow: autonomous execution, epistemic verification, structural maintenance, post-hoc skill blame.

plugins.name: swarm
plugins.description: Autonomous orchestration: hand off a task end-to-end, sub-agents do the work, main session reports only on completion.

plugins.name: lens
plugins.description: Epistemic primitives for Claude Code: dispatched sub-agents with adversarial roles + external tool grounding to break single-context reasoning ceilings.

plugins.name: tend
plugins.description: Lint a .md library for structural integrity: file size cap, broken cross-links, orphan files, required sections.

plugins.name: postmortem
plugins.description: Post-hoc skill blame attribution. Reads a JSONL transcript + symptom, identifies which skill broke its declared contract, cites evidence.
